budget_note: With max_iterations=12 (issue §7.4) and the full split, one iteration costs at most (4 train + 40 val) x 3 = 132 rollouts; seed val = 120. Worst case 120 + 12 x 132 = 1,704 < R=2,160, so max_iterations (not R) normally ends an EvoSkill search; iterations whose 4 train samples all pass skip the val eval (12 rollouts). The iteration guard only binds if R < 1,704. Reported, not changed.

data.optimizer_sees: train 80 (official split train), pooled by instruction_type (Cell-Level 53, Sheet-Level 27); per iteration 2 tasks per pool are sampled round-robin. For each sampled task that FAILS (k=3 mean < 2/3) the proposer sees the per-trial rewards, the scorer's gold-safe feedback and the lowest-scoring trial's transcript (<= 20k chars). Plus EvoSkill's feedback history: per child, the proposal, justification, outcome and the VAL score vs the parent's VAL score.
data.selects_on: val 40 (official split val): every child program is scored on all of val (k=3 per task, pass/fail at mean >= 2/3, mean over tasks); frontier (size 3) membership and best-parent selection use that val score
data.aggregate_feedback_to_optimizer_from_val: yes: the val score of each child and its parent is written into feedback_history.md (upstream behaviour)
data.test: never loaded by the port; the launcher asserts zero overlap with the official test list; CapEvolveBaseAgent refuses any task id outside this search's train/val list
